mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested kitchen locations or coffee_table_l1. On Day 29, it was at kitchen_table_k1 at 07:52 and desk_o1 at 11:15. The assumption that it stays at the office desk during work hours is incorrect; it moves to the kitchen table in the early morning (pre-09:00) and returns to the office desk by late morning (11:00+). Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning queries and desk_o1 for late morning/afternoon queries.

charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late afternoon. On Day 28, it was at desk_o1 at 10:53, 14:43, and 15:46. The assumption that it moves to the bedroom nightstand during the day is incorrect; it remains at the office desk throughout the workday (09:00-18:00). Check desk_o1 for all daytime queries. For late night (22:00+), continue checking nightstand_b1 as per previous evidence, as no new late-night data contradicts this.

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested dining_table_d1 for early evening. On Day 29, it was at desk_o1 at 18:18. The assumption that it moves to the dining table in the early evening is incorrect; it remains at the office desk at least until 18:00. Check desk_o1 for late morning (09:00-12:00) and early evening (18:00-21:00) queries.
